_readme: FROZEN. Do not regenerate this file; it is not a golden.
It is the shape kno's --json contract emitted at the v0.1.0 tag: one entry per key
that v0.1.0 emitted UNCONDITIONALLY, with the JSON type it emitted. Derived from
the struct tags of jsonReport, valueReport, selectReport, exportReport and
reportJSON in cli/jsonreport.go at v0.1.0. Keys tagged omitempty there are absent
here, because their absence is legal and pinning them would fail on legal output.
TestV01ShapeIsStillASubset asserts every key below still exists with the same type.
A PR that edits this file is renaming, removing or retyping a released key and owes
a CHANGELOG migration note per ADR-0006 rule 2. Adding keys to the output is free;
adding them here is not, and is not what this file is for.
